$comment: Cross-entry intent fidelity: the same words through /request (runRequest, fixture parser), the agent (runGoal, scripted planner) and a REST place_order with the lines a person would type must give the same basket. The agent needs an order verb and a kitchen in its goal, so it gets `agentText`: the same request in its phrasing. Expectations are properties (date, physical amount, constraint, category), never the first search hit. Runner: src/lib/server/evals/fidelity.test.ts. Today = scenario start, Mon 7 Dec 2026.
